description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Lightning with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Lightning Mode I: Prompto] and [Lightning Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Lightning Mode I: Prompto
description.text: Lightning abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Lightning abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00, causes [Imperil Lightning 10% (15s)] after casting two equipped Lightning abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1], [Dual Trigger Spark Mode] and [Dual Awoken Lightning Mode II: Prompto], removes [Dual Awoken Lightning Mode I: Prompto]
